## Summary
Phase P0 (Decisions & scope) documentation for the Parent Journey redesign.

- Records positions on product decisions P1–P14 (including parked decisions D-P1 and D-P4).
- Maps all 35 artboards across 7 journeys from the design canvas (\Claude outputs/mindmosaic-parent-journey.html\) to Next.js routes and target components.
- Analyzes existing backend services (\BUILT ALREADY\) vs missing capabilities (\NEEDS A BUILD\).
- Enforces non-negotiable honesty rules: server confirmation gate, zero performance bands on parent screens, claim evidence floor (>= 2 papers and >= 8 marks), isolated practice previews, and no unratified SLA commitments.
- Documents the exact path of the DangerZone component (\src/features/parent-dashboard/components/DangerZone.tsx\) implementing the ADR-012 30-day verified deletion request model.
- Includes follow-up advisory note on \performanceBand()\ in \src/features/landing/chapter4-progress.ts\ (lines 148–201) labeling off a single paper without an evidence floor.

## Verification
- Docs only (no application code changed).
- \
pm run typecheck\: passed with 0 errors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
